executive_summary: Build an automated daily Snowflake pipeline to ingest aerospace parts inventory data from a source database into a target database. The pipeline will apply SCD Type 1 overwrite, deduplication by latest UPDATED_AT, incremental loads, soft deletes, mandatory reconciliation logging, and data transformations including MANUFACTURER uppercasing, WEIGHT_KG cleansing, and a derived RISK_SCORE column. SLA target is 1 million records within 5 minutes.
business_objectives: Automate daily ingestion of aerospace parts inventory data into Snowflake for reporting and analytics
Ensure data quality through deduplication, standardization, and cleansing transformations
Support compliance, procurement analysis, and operations with accurate, analytics-ready data
Achieve SLA of processing 1 million records within 5 minutes per run
Maintain full reconciliation audit trail per pipeline execution
current_state: Aerospace parts inventory data exists in a source system (AEROSPACE_PARTS_SOURCE) but lacks an automated, standardized pipeline to deliver clean, deduplicated, analytics-ready data to a target reporting environment.
future_state: A scalable, automated Snowflake pipeline runs daily at 05:00 UTC, loading deduplicated, transformed, and reconciled aerospace parts data into AEROSPACE_PARTS_TARGET with full SLA compliance and reconciliation logging.
scope_in: Incremental and full load pipeline from AEROSPACE_PARTS_SOURCE to AEROSPACE_PARTS_TARGET
SCD Type 1 (overwrite, no history) strategy keyed on PART_NUMBER
Deduplication logic retaining the latest record by UPDATED_AT
Soft delete handling: records missing from source marked as Decommissioned
Mandatory reconciliation logging to ETL_RECONCILIATION_LOG per run
SLA enforcement: 1 million records within 5 minutes
scope_out: SCD Type 2 or historical change tracking
Source system modifications or upstream data fixes
Transformation rules beyond those specified in the MOM

functional_requirements.text: The pipeline must perform an incremental load using UPDATED_AT greater than the last successful execution timestamp. The first run must perform a full load.
The pipeline must deduplicate source records by PART_NUMBER, retaining only the latest record based on UPDATED_AT before loading into the target.
The pipeline must implement SCD Type 1 strategy, overwriting existing target records matched by PART_NUMBER with no history retention.
The pipeline must perform soft deletes: records present in the target but absent from the current source extract must have their status set to Decommissioned.
The MANUFACTURER field must be converted to uppercase during transformation.
The WEIGHT_KG field must be cleansed by replacing any value less than or equal to 0 with -1.
A derived column RISK_SCORE must be calculated for each part record based on certification status and lead time according to defined business rules.
A mandatory reconciliation check must be performed after every pipeline run and results must be logged to ETL_RECONCILIATION_LOG.
The pipeline must be scheduled to execute daily at 05:00 UTC.

non_functional_requirements.text: The pipeline must process up to 1 million records within 5 minutes to meet the defined SLA.
The pipeline must be scalable to handle volume growth without architectural redesign.
The pipeline must be automated with no manual intervention required for standard daily runs.
All pipeline executions must produce auditable reconciliation logs for compliance purposes.
The Snowflake warehouse must be provisioned and available prior to the 05:00 UTC scheduled execution window.

business_rules.text: Incremental load condition: extract records from source where UPDATED_AT is greater than the last successful execution timestamp.
On the first pipeline run (no prior execution timestamp exists), perform a full load of all source records.
When duplicate PART_NUMBER records exist in the source extract, retain only the record with the maximum UPDATED_AT value.
Apply SCD Type 1: match target records by PART_NUMBER and overwrite all non-key attributes with source values; do not retain historical versions.
Any PART_NUMBER present in the target but not present in the current source extract must be updated with status set to Decommissioned (soft delete).
Transform MANUFACTURER field value to uppercase (e.g., UPPER(MANUFACTURER)).
If WEIGHT_KG is less than or equal to 0, replace the value with -1; otherwise retain the original value.
RISK_SCORE = 'High Risk' when certification status is Pending AND lead time exceeds 60 days.
RISK_SCORE = 'Medium Risk' when certification status is Pending OR lead time exceeds 100 days (and the High Risk condition is not met).
RISK_SCORE = 'Low Risk' when certification status is one of FAA, EASA, or Dual AND lead time is 60 days or less.
RISK_SCORE = 'Medium Risk' for all cases not covered by BR-08, BR-09, or BR-10.
After every pipeline run, reconciliation results (source count, target count, inserted, updated, soft-deleted, discrepancies) must be logged to ETL_RECONCILIATION_LOG.

kpis: Pipeline execution time: must process 1 million records within 5 minutes
Reconciliation pass rate: 100% of runs must produce a reconciliation log entry
Soft delete accuracy: all decommissioned parts correctly flagged per run
Deduplication rate: zero duplicate PART_NUMBER records in target post-load
Schedule adherence: pipeline executes daily at 05:00 UTC without manual intervention
data_transformations: Convert MANUFACTURER field to uppercase using UPPER() function
Replace WEIGHT_KG values less than or equal to 0 with -1
Derive RISK_SCORE column based on certification status and lead time business rules
Deduplicate source records by PART_NUMBER retaining maximum UPDATED_AT
Apply soft delete flag (Decommissioned) to target records absent from source extract

calculated_columns.name: RISK_SCORE
calculated_columns.logic: CASE WHEN CERTIFICATION_STATUS = 'Pending' AND LEAD_TIME_DAYS > 60 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN (CERTIFICATION_STATUS = 'Pending' OR LEAD_TIME_DAYS > 100) THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN CERTIFICATION_STATUS IN ('FAA', 'EASA', 'Dual') AND LEAD_TIME_DAYS <= 60 THEN 'Low Risk' ELSE 'Medium Risk' END

filters: Full load filter: no filter applied on first run (all source records extracted)
dependencies: Business Analyst must deliver the BRD before pipeline development begins
Architecture must validate Snowflake warehouse availability and scheduling configuration
All stakeholders must review and approve transformation rules before QA testing
QA must prepare test scenarios aligned to transformation and reconciliation rules
Snowflake warehouse must be provisioned prior to the 05:00 UTC daily schedule
risks: Invalid or unexpected certification values may break RISK_SCORE derivation logic
High data volumes may threaten the 5-minute SLA under peak conditions
Inconsistent or delayed source system updates may cause incremental processing gaps
Future business requirement changes may necessitate pipeline redesign
Warehouse provisioning or scheduling delays may cause missed execution windows
assumptions: PART_NUMBER is the unique business key in both source and target
UPDATED_AT is a reliable and consistently populated timestamp in the source system
The last successful execution timestamp is persisted and accessible by the pipeline at runtime
Valid certification status values are limited to: Pending, FAA, EASA, Dual (plus any others defaulting to Medium Risk)
The Snowflake warehouse will be available and sized appropriately to meet the 5-minute SLA
The first pipeline run with no prior execution timestamp will perform a full load

acceptance_criteria.text: On the first run, all records from the source are loaded into the target with no UPDATED_AT filter applied.
On subsequent runs, only records with UPDATED_AT greater than the last successful execution timestamp are extracted and processed.
After each load, no duplicate PART_NUMBER values exist in AEROSPACE_PARTS_TARGET.
When multiple source records share the same PART_NUMBER, only the record with the latest UPDATED_AT is loaded.
Existing target records matched by PART_NUMBER are overwritten with source values; no historical versions are retained.
All PART_NUMBER records present in the target but absent from the source extract have their status updated to Decommissioned.
All MANUFACTURER values in AEROSPACE_PARTS_TARGET are stored in uppercase after each pipeline run.
All WEIGHT_KG values less than or equal to 0 in the target are stored as -1 after transformation.
RISK_SCORE is populated as 'High Risk' for all parts where CERTIFICATION_STATUS = 'Pending' and LEAD_TIME_DAYS > 60.
RISK_SCORE is populated as 'Low Risk' for all parts where CERTIFICATION_STATUS is FAA, EASA, or Dual and LEAD_TIME_DAYS <= 60.
RISK_SCORE is populated as 'Medium Risk' for all parts not meeting High Risk or Low Risk conditions.
A reconciliation record is written to ETL_RECONCILIATION_LOG after every pipeline run, including source count, target count, and any discrepancies.
The pipeline executes automatically at 05:00 UTC daily without manual intervention.
A load of 1 million records completes within 5 minutes as measured from pipeline start to reconciliation log write.
